header.userPrompt:
Extract a shared helper for mui.Autocomplete to remove the repeated js.Dynamic prop-setting block across the web frontend. Implements issue #120. Pure refactor, no behaviour change.

## Problem
Every `mui.Autocomplete` call site repeats the same ~18-line construction: build `AutocompleteProps[...]`, cast to `js.Dynamic`, and assign `freeSolo` / `size` / `fullWidth` / `inputValue` / `getOptionLabel` / `onChange` / `onInputChange`. The ScalablyTyped fluent builder does not expose those props, so this cast-and-mutate dance (documented as RULE-FE-012 in `docs/guide/frontend.md`) is unavoidable per site, but it is duplicated, verbose, and easy to get subtly wrong.

The block currently appears, 2 to 3 times each, in these files under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/`:
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowRuleForm.scala`
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowCreateExpenseForm.scala`
- `components/pages/bankstatementreview/BankRowCreateRefundForm.scala`
- `components/pages/receipts/ReceiptsPage.scala`
- `components/pages/importrules/ImportRulesPage.scala`
- `components/pages/expenses/BulkExpenseCreationPage.scala`
- `components/pages/merchants/BulkMerchantSetupPage.scala`
- `components/pages/merchants/MerchantReviewPage.scala`

The merchant/category type-aheads are the common shape: a free-solo, single-select Autocomplete over a labeled list, controlled by `inputValue`, with an `onSelect` and an `onInput`.

Start by reading `BankRowRuleForm.scala` (the canonical copy of the block) and `MuiCompat.scala` plus `AutocompleteLabels` to see the existing shared helpers, then inspect every call site above to catalog the real variations before designing the helper.

## Proposal
Add a small helper (e.g. in `MuiCompat`, alongside the existing compat helpers) that builds a configured `AutocompleteProps` for the common free-solo single-select case from a few parameters: options, label, `inputValue`, `getOptionLabel`, `onSelect`, `onInput`. This collapses each block to one call and keeps the `js.Dynamic` mutation in exactly one place. Then convert the call sites to use it.

## Constraints (must follow)
- Reads of the selected value in callbacks must stay on the `(value: Any) match { case x: T => ... }` pattern (and the shared `AutocompleteLabels`); reading Scala case-class fields off `js.Dynamic` returns undefined because the fields are name-mangled. The helper must only centralise prop-SETTING, not field reads. Do NOT move the `(value: Any) match` reads into the helper.
- Pure refactor, no behaviour change. Keep per-site specifics (e.g. the create-expense merchant selection cascading its default category) at the call site via the `onSelect` callback.
- If a call site has a genuinely different shape (not free-solo, not single-select, or extra props the helper does not cover), leave it as-is rather than forcing it through the helper or widening the helper with speculative parameters. Only convert the sites that match the common shape. Note in the PR body which sites, if any, were left unconverted and why.
- Custom wart `NamedArguments`: when a call passes 2 or more arguments of the same type, they MUST be passed by name or compilation fails. Design the helper's signature and update call sites accordingly.
- Match existing style. Do not reformat or "improve" adjacent code. Every changed line must trace to this refactor.
- Update `docs/guide/frontend.md` RULE-FE-012 so it points at the new helper as the one place the cast-and-mutate lives, instead of describing it as per-site boilerplate. Do not renumber other rules.

## Conventions
- Follow `docs/guide/` (architecture.md, frontend.md, testing.md, antipatterns.md, ci-checklist.md).
- Public repository: no PII anywhere in code, comments, or the PR text. The PR description must NOT contain any claude.ai session link.

## Verification / acceptance criteria
- `web/compile` succeeds (Scala.js), the frontend still builds, and `CI=true sbt Test/compile` is clean.
- Existing web tests still pass unchanged (this is a pure refactor); run the web test suite. Do not weaken or delete tests to make them pass.
- Each converted call site behaves identically: same options, same label, same `inputValue` control, same selection cascade and input handling as before.
- The ~18-line js.Dynamic block no longer appears duplicated across the converted sites; it lives in the single helper.
- No behaviour change anywhere in the app.
